title: 5 money habits that keep you poor without realizing

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: What if the habits we think are harmless are actually sabotaging our financial future?

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Algorithms now track spending patterns, but many apps prioritize engagement over empowerment, using nudges to encourage overspending.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: This creates a cycle where users are manipulated into debt without realizing it, deepening inequality and eroding financial autonomy.

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Builders are developing transparent fintech tools that use blockchain for auditability and AI for honest, goal-oriented budgeting.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: A future where financial apps act as trusted advisors, helping people build wealth through clarity and ethical design is within reach.

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: The future of finance will be shaped by those who build with transparency and those who demand it.

video_cue: A person using a transparent financial app that displays real-time budget insights and ethical spending alerts.
